lines.en: I wind my way over the ground.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴着一道沙脊
lines.en: My body hugs a sand ridge.
Under the sand, I slide along.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在沙上留下纹路
lines.en: My scales leave a pattern in the sand.
I advance a length at a time.
I slide into the shade of the brush.
My head goes first.

lines.zh: 我沿着干裂的土缝移动
lines.en: I follow the cracks in the dry earth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滑进沙丘的背面
lines.en: I slide behind the dune.
My tail is the last to leave.

lines.zh: 我在沙上几乎没有重量
lines.en: I barely weigh on the sand.
I bend away toward the other side.
I press to the ground and listen.
I come out from under a stone.
I avoid that stretch of hot sand.
I slowly half-bury myself.
I coil in the sand with only a little showing.
The sand is warm from the sun.
I lie still like a root.
My tongue slips out once.
I am waiting for the ground to shake.
It is too hot here by day.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴着凉的那一侧
lines.en: I keep to the cooler side.
Most of me is buried.
I raise my head slowly.
Wind blows sand over my back.
I listen for footsteps far off.
No one would notice me.
I coil tighter.
I raise my head out of the sand.
You stand, I lie on the ground.
I am longer than you think.
I do not need legs to reach you.
My eyes have no lids.
Do not move too quickly.
I am measuring your ankle.
The sand under you is shifting.
I sink back down, slowly.
I draw back half my length.
My scales are scraped open.
That bite hurt deep.
I twist in the sand.
I cannot lift my head.
Blood drips onto the sand.
I ease myself away.
This body can still move.
I am keeping that blow in memory.
Is that something alive?
I raise my head and look a long while.
I do not eat this.
Leave it and do not touch it.
I will wait for it to cool.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，我的蛇身动了一下。
lines.en: Beneath the sand, my body shifts once.
It needs far more than this.
I swallow; I do not chew.
Not your hand, that close.
I ease closer.
You stepped on me.
I slid off a length.
You pinned part of me.
Do not step down; I am at your feet.
I flow around your feet.
We kick the sand apart.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的靴子
lines.en: My tail brushes your boot.
I have remembered that pressure.
I coil up again.
We coil together.
It is cooler under the sand.
Her body is slimmer than mine.
Neither of us needs to speak.
This hollow is big enough for two.
I ease over to her.
We bury ourselves together.
Her scales brush mine.
We share the same shade.
We will speak after dark.
I swallow what falls on the sand.
This is too big.
I curl my body around it.
This thing is quite hard.
Whoever dropped it, I do not care.
I bury it in the sand.
I sniff and let it go.
It is caught between my scales.
Not worth me moving for.
You are standing on my sand.
I have raised my head out.
My mark is on you.
I am already at your feet.
There is nowhere to retreat to.
The sand will tell you I am here.
I slowly raise my front half.
Your warmth stands out.
I have no need to run.
I prepared this strike a long while.
Let me judge how heavy you are.
I move toward you along the sand.
Around behind you. Quick.
When you turn, I stop.

lines.zh: 我在地面下也能感觉到你
lines.en: I feel you even under the sand.
Half of me is out of sight.
I wait for you to settle.
My head is raised high.
Sand slides off my scales.
I make no sound at all.
The stone will not save you.
I edge closer to you.
I know this sand well.
Do you hear the sand move?

lines.zh: 我的身子绕上了你的腿
lines.en: My body winds around your leg.
You are pulled down.
My teeth drag backward.
I coil one and a half turns.
Your breathing tightens.
I do not loosen my grip.
I churn the sand up.
You loosened it a little.
I coil on another turn.
That will slow you down.
I ease away.

lines.zh: 阿根廷的沙下，我半穴居。
lines.en: Under Argentine sand, I half-burrow.
A ripple crosses the sand.

lines.zh: 我在这片沙丘下住下了
lines.en: I have settled under this dune.
The sand here is loose enough.
I slide out from under a stone.
The sun has made the sand hot.
I coil with one eye showing.
The wind covers my tracks.
I raise my head to look at the waste.
Few come here.
I unfold slowly.
My scales are the colour of the sand.
I have found a patch of shade.
Fire sears my scales.
I slide off the rock.
The blast throws me out of the sand.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉穿了我的身体
lines.en: An arrow pins through me.
Magic burns at my core.
Nothing living is left in this sand.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙丘上，我僵了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes the dune and I stiffen.
The sand is gone.
